headline: Approved September 9 minutes and fire chief's report; updates covered recruits, a headquarters roof, and overtime.
summary: The fire chief reported one firefighter injured on duty and one on light duty. Overtime spending so far is $299,103.37 of a $506,356.00 budget, leaving $207,252.63. Three of five new recruits have passed their medicals, and the plan is for all of them to begin in January 2027.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 9, 2026 meeting; motion carried.
Accepted the Fire Chief's report; motion carried.
